description: SuperLU_DIST parallel direct linear solver support for MatrixCSR systems.
notes: For advanced solver requirements, prefer PETSc/petsc4py.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Solve Au = b. Returns SuperLU_DIST return integer (0 = success). Caller must u.scatter_forward() after.

methods.name: set_A
methods.description: Set assembled LHS matrix for reuse with 'Factor' option.

functions.name: superlu_dist_matrix
functions.description: Create a SuperLU_DIST matrix (deep copy from MatrixCSR A).

functions.name: superlu_dist_solver
functions.description: Create a SuperLU_DIST solver via LU decomposition.
